statements.query: MATCH ((n:AzureSQLServer)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})) WHERE n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL OR n.exposed_internet_type IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH ((n:AzureSQLDatabase)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSQLServer)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})) WHERE n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL OR n.exposed_internet_type IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (fw:AzureFirewallRule)<-[:HAS]-(sql:AzureSQLServer)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE coalesce(sql.publicNetworkAccess, '') <> 'Disabled' AND coalesce(fw.address_count, 4294967296) > 16777216 SET sql.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_firewall' IN coalesce(sql.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN sql END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(sql.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'unrestricted_firewall';

MATCH (sql:AzureSQLServer)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE coalesce(sql.publicNetworkAccess, '') <> 'Disabled' AND coalesce(sql.engine, 'sqlserver') <> 'sqlserver' SET sql.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'firewall_not_evaluated' IN coalesce(sql.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN sql END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(sql.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'firewall_not_evaluated';

MATCH (fw:AzureFirewallRule)<-[:HAS]-(sql:AzureSQLServer)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE coalesce(sql.publicNetworkAccess, '') <> 'Disabled' AND fw.start_ip_address = '0.0.0.0' AND fw.end_ip_address = '0.0.0.0' SET (CASE WHEN NOT 'azure_services_allowed' IN coalesce(sql.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN sql END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(sql.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'azure_services_allowed';

MATCH (db:AzureSQLDatabase)<-[:RESOURCE]-(sql:AzureSQLServer{exposed_internet: true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) SET db.exposed_internet = true, db.exposed_internet_type = sql.exposed_internet_type;

MATCH (sql:AzureSQLServer)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE sql.exposed_internet = true WITH sql OPTIONAL MATCH (fw:AzureFirewallRule)<-[:HAS]-(sql) WHERE coalesce(fw.address_count, 4294967296) > 16777216 OR (fw.start_ip_address = '0.0.0.0' AND fw.end_ip_address = '0.0.0.0') WITH sql, collect(DISTINCT {firewallRuleId: fw.id, startIp: fw.start_ip_address, endIp: fw.end_ip_address}) as firewallRules SET sql.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: sql.id, resourceType: 'azure-database-sqlserver', context: [{serverId: sql.id, serverName: sql.name, fullyQualifiedDomainName: sql.fully_qualified_domain_name, version: sql.version, publicNetworkAccess: sql.publicNetworkAccess, exposureTypes: sql.exposed_internet_type, firewallRules: firewallRules, location: sql.location}]}])

MATCH (db:AzureSQLDatabase)<-[:RESOURCE]-(sql:AzureSQLServer)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE db.exposed_internet = true WITH db, sql SET db.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: db.id, resourceType: 'azure-database-sqldatabase', context: [{databaseId: db.id, databaseName: db.name, serverId: sql.id, serverName: sql.name, exposureTypes: db.exposed_internet_type, maxSizeBytes: db.max_size_bytes, status: db.status}]}])
